name: OSS_MRA_MATRIX
description: Captures matrix metadata for batch flows.

columns.name: FAMILY_CODE
columns.description: Name for service mapping datasources used.

columns.name: SOURCE_CODE_NAME
columns.description: Dimension source name in matrix setup.

columns.name: FACT_SM_SOURCE
columns.description: Business object mapped to dimension source.

columns.name: FACT_SM_VO_ATTRIBUTE
columns.description: Service mapping view attribute mapped to entity attribute.

columns.name: FACT_SM_DB_ATTRIBUTE
columns.description: Service mapping DB  attribute mapped to view attribute.

columns.name: DIMENSION_DB_ATTRIBUTE
columns.description: Attribute in QP_MATRIX_RULES_VL table that stores the value of a matrix rule condition.

columns.name: DIMENSION_OPERATOR
columns.description: Operator used in matrix rule condition.

columns.name: DIMENSION_DATA_TYPE
columns.description: Data type of matrix rule condition.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
